strongest_angle: Examining the Labour Department prosecution of Fine Point Transportation Co., Limited following a fatal 2025 workplace accident in Kwai Chung involving stacked gypsum boards, resulting in a 140,000 dollar fine under the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance.

key_facts.fact: Fine Point Transportation Co., Limited was fined $140,000 at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on November 5, 2026, for violating the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance.
key_facts.source_name: Government of Hong Kong Information Services Department

key_facts.fact: The fatal accident occurred in November 2025 at an open-air car park in Kwai Chung, where a male worker was crushed by vertically stored gypsum boards that suddenly toppled.
The prosecution against Fine Point Transportation Co., Limited was officially launched by the Labour Department following the fatal workplace safety breach.
key_facts.source_name: Government of Hong Kong Information Services Department
